title: Zesty Buttery Peruvian Rice Arroz Con Pato
description: Buttery and snappy Peruvian dish featuring cream and leaf wrap steam, perfect for a comforting meal, this plant-based friendly arroz con pato is a twist on the classic.
instructions: In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the rice to the saucepan and stir to coat the rice with the butter.
Add the vegetable broth, coconut cream, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 18 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, prepare the leaf wrap by cutting a piece of parchment paper into a large square.
After the rice has cooked for 18 minutes, stir in the frozen peas and carrots, chopped scallions, and lime juice.
To steam the rice, place the saucepan over a pot of boiling water, cover with the parchment paper leaf wrap, and steam for 5 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the chopped cilantro.
Serve the arroz con pato hot, garnished with additional chopped cilantro if desired.
